name: wherewhen
description: Read and edit one Wherewhen trip: its days, stops and unscheduled ideas, through the trip's Wherewhen agent API. Days have no stored date and cannot be reordered; add a day at the end or remove one. Pass "ideas" as the dayId to work with unscheduled stops. A placeholder (a stop added by name instead of placeId) inherits the previous stop's location and cannot be the first stop of a day (use a real place or index >= 1). pinnedTime and pinnedEndTime are HH:mm in the place's local time and may run past midnight, up to 47:59; send null to clear a fixed time. legMode is one of auto, walk, drive, cycle or other. notes is free text of at most 2000 characters; send null or an empty string to clear it. To add a real place, find it with search_places and then add_stop with its placeId. Every write returns the full updated trip.
summary: Read and edit a trip's days, stops and ideas

trip_token.description: The trip's Wherewhen agent link, or just the token from it (the part after /api/agent/). In Wherewhen, open the trip and choose its agent link, then paste the whole URL here; the full URL and the bare token are both accepted.
